locations.note: Yosemite Valley's granite walls and meadows are stitched into the single map for bike and wingsuit runs.
Bryce Canyon's hoodoos form one of the seven US national parks merged into the Republic's map.
The Grand Teton peaks are the snowy side of the mashup map, home to ski and snowboard events.
The map combines recognizable Sequoia mountain landscapes with other western parks.
The playable map includes Zion's sandstone cliffs and canyons.
The map recreates the red-rock terrain of Canyonlands.
The game includes the recognizable Mammoth Mountain ski area.
